sourceGaps: All six available worked keys are present and retained; no invented answer or third B1 main part.

sourceContradictions.description: OriginalQ uses Tmax and statesX=C. Key repeatedQ uses400K and saysXmaynotoccuratC. Worked keyPT/PV graphs and explanatory solution nevertheless coincideC/X/Y and putC oncoexistence. Original question, both changed key clauses, all key figures/prose/grading ranges retained.
Original question says three independently solvable parts; matching key says two. Actual native a/b tasks only; no third part invented.
Both piston40.0kg and added weight120.0kg are assigned symbolm. Same printed symbol retained.
Key calls maximum possible acceleration of top block but writesmbamax=mu mtg. Printed wording/equation retained.
Key acceleration usesT rather than questionTb and begins0=dp/dt=(dm/dt)v+m(dv/dt). Exact source derivation retained.
Printed exact field is−mu0qm/(4pi z²)+mu0qm/[4pi(z+d)²] although question places+qm atz=d; the next simplified expression is positive. Printed denominator/sign transition retained.
Original prints Assume the that; wording retained. Ampère accented name normalized only to equivalent precomposedUnicode.
Key prints parallel place capacitor after earlier parallel plate capacitor. Source word place retained.
Supervisor refers to answer-sheetpages14–14 although actual lastPDFpage23 bearsprinted14; complete source bytes/pages retained with exactPDFindices.
Key numerics useg=10m/s² rather than cover9.8N/kg; printed approximate40/160kPa preserved.
Native log-volume axis includes0 then1/10/...; original printed0 retained in final answer-sheet crop, no editorial redrawing.
